fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the presence of the keywords "lsass" and ".dmp" in the commandline, which could indicate a potential attempt to dump or create a dump of the lsass process.
fields.name: LSASS Dump Keyword In CommandLine
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "lsass.dmp" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "lsass.zip" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "lsass.rar" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "Andrew.dmp" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "Coredump.dmp" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "NotLSASS.zip" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "lsass_2" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "lsassdump" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "lsassdmp") or (tgt.process.cmdline contains "lsass" and tgt.process.cmdline contains ".dmp") or (tgt.process.cmdline contains "SQLDmpr" and tgt.process.cmdline contains ".mdmp") or (tgt.process.cmdline contains "nanodump" and tgt.process.cmdline contains ".dmp")))
